status: Owner-authorized diagnostic, not a formal statistical study

time.control: equal per-move allowance; untimed native MatchRecord
time.meaning: Both receive go movetime1000 only; no external depth/node handicap. Natural early finish and each engine time-management policy remain. Equal allowance is not identical actual CPU usage.

resources.hardware: Same Apple M1 Pro/32GiB macOS27 host; sequential games, one search thread per engine, no pondering
resources.mshogi: Frozen conventional/classical engine, internal4096-entry TT, no external book/model/tablebases
resources.memory: Modest native cache policies are recorded, not claimed byte-equal: mShogi4096 TT entries vs Stockfish16MB Hash plus embedded98.5MB NNUE. No swapping/large memory handicap intended. Stockfish defaults remain full strength.

population.selection: Four familiar authored orthodox opening prefixes, chosen before diagnostic results; not held-out or representative statistical sampling. Prior exposure is immaterial to this explicitly diagnostic comparison.
population.pairing: Adjacent two games per prefix: mShogi White then Black, same complete native history.

stopping.budget_includes: All active local match invocation wall time, including prior5.840419957879931s smoke, failed attempts and cleanup; sequential, no paidcompute. Build/replay/offline diagnostic inspection excluded from matchwork.
stopping.admission: Stop new pairs with less than60s remaining; each launch reserves5s cleanup from remaining allowance. Hard outer group deadline prevents budget extension. Preserve partial outputs and unscored caps.
stopping.failure: Stop on process/protocol/cleanup failure; do not replace games. Healthy games reaching256 totalplies remain unscored, then continue scheduled openings within budget. Eight attempted games planned; no additional batches or score-based stopping.

analysis.report: Descriptive W/D/L and unscored attempts, observed nominal/selective depth, visits/time, performance limitations and representative loss mechanisms with concrete native positions/actions. Separate observations from plausible explanations.
analysis.scope: Eight-game initial diagnostic only; no statistical significance, confidence interval, Elo estimate, parity claim or numeric release-strength threshold.
analysis.handoff: Establish initial conventional Chess baseline, then prioritize Shogi and Xiangqi. No repeated small Chess benchmarking; deeper Chess strength analysis during learned-evaluation research.
